core.text: Observed anchor: one 300 rpm trial stopped at second 60 and achieved approximately 2.4 percent final-vial spread. This bounds the asserted necessity of sustained 900 rpm but establishes neither reliable lower-speed sufficiency nor the cause of fluctuating 900 rpm images. Rival futures below are hypotheses.

Account A successful future: a timer-stopped 900 rpm trial and its enabled-rule counterpart both achieve final-vial spread at most 4 percent, while the timer trial uses less stirring despite failed shadow checks. Backcast: unnecessary extensions renew agitation-related image disturbance. The first causal divergence is allowing versus withholding the optical instruction to continue after the precommitted second-60 stop; neither disturbance identity nor an operating feedback loop is already observed.

Incompatible Account B successful future: unresolved gradients at second 60 cause the timer trial to exceed 4 percent final-vial spread, whereas additional rule-enabled stirring achieves at most 4 percent. Backcast: redistribution remains incomplete when optical failures command extension; added rotation improves the sample outcome. This predicts a useful extension in the pair, without establishing necessity of 900 rpm or this particular rule.

Preserve the first-divergence probe: propose three fresh enabled-versus-timer 900 rpm pairs, reversing trial order across pairs. Timer trials stop at second 60 irrespective of images; enabled trials apply the stipulated rule and stop by 105. Log shadow decisions in both, actual cessation, five-second images before and after cessation, depression, specks and stirring duration. Sample all at second 120, alternating depth order; keep recipe, addition location, dye bottle, references and camera fixed. Use the spill tray and stop on escape. Account A predicts both sample targets with timer savings and potentially prompt image improvement on cessation; B predicts timer failure and enabled success.

residue.text: Specks do not establish bubbles; reference repeatability is not concentration calibration. Matched 900 rpm final samples are absent. Sampling disturbance, unverified nominal speed and limited replication restrict inference; other recipes and scales remain untested.

Record every failure and unequal quiet durations before sampling. Both failures, absent duration separation, or mixed repeats leave these accounts unresolved. Both passing with timer savings supports dispensable extension under these conditions, but cannot establish pre-stop uniformity; settling and optical changes could explain rapid image improvement.

tension.account_a: Hypothesis: optical failures after adequate bulk mixing provoke unnecessary, disturbance-renewing extensions.
tension.account_b: Rival hypothesis: those failures reflect unresolved gradients and extensions are required for this paired sample outcome.
tension.prediction_a: Timer and enabled trials both pass final samples; timer uses less stirring despite shadow failures.
tension.prediction_b: Timer fails final samples while the longer enabled trial passes.
